summary_md: **AgentsWatch ([@AgentsWatch](https://x.com/AgentsWatch/status/2116439573928743096))** summarizes *Network Topology Does Not Matter* by Sahil Rajesh Dhayalkar ([arXiv 2610.37699](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37699)): across 73,080 exchanges among eight LLMs, the classical consensus assumptions (convex updates, conserved means, content-independent weights) fail, and in 10,000-agent simulations topology explains almost nothing while half the models converge on confidently false beliefs.
